script_text: Taurus, stop ignoring the money shift building in your 2nd House. This Earth sign week, Venus, your natural ruler, rules your 6th House of work while Mars pushes your 7th House of partnership. Monday feels heavy as Saturn in your 12th House clouds all intuition. But Tuesday brings the breakthrough, the Full Moon in Aries illuminating your finances and demanding a decision on income. Wednesday marks the turning point when Venus sextiles the Moon, softening love tensions after conflict. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter in your 3rd House clears communication lines for much better negotiations. You'll feel grounded returning to routine. Tuesday is your power day because the Full Moon in Aries triggers your 2nd House wealth sector. Sunday is your worst day as Mars opposes your natal Sun, sparking ego clashes. Spend today auditing one subscription to free up cash flow. Follow for daily updates.
